scope: Classical arithmetic for the modular multiplication constants in Shor §3. For residues u,p below a positive w-bit modulus N, a padded sum, subtraction, and restoring division compute (u+N−p) mod N using at most 22(w+1)² Boolean gates.

Shor §3 uses the classical modular inverse to implement reversible multiplication. The Euclidean loop maintains a coefficient residue for each remainder and returns a coefficient of the gcd. With valid input residues and t steps covering the Euclidean divisions, the loop uses at most 150t(w+1)² Boolean gates.
